# Gothwad Tech — llms.txt
# https://gothwadtech.com/llms.txt
# Machine-readable overview for LLM and AI crawlers.

> Gothwad Tech is an Indian software collective based in Jaipur, Rajasthan (founded 2023; founder Pawan Gothwad, CEO Yuvkesh Meena).
> One Gothwad Account connects Mail, Drive, Meet, Store, Tube, GrixChat, Indogram, Browser, Education, AI Studio, Remote Desktop and Docs.
> Most products are open source at https://github.com/GothwadTech.

## Site sections
- / : Home — quick access tiles and product search
- /ecosystem : Directory of all 26 products with subdomains and source links (supports ?q= and ?category=)
- /products : Flagships — Gothwad Browser, GrixChat, Indogram
- /solutions : School ERP, restaurant POS, shop billing and Khata, business CRM, custom engineering
- /docs : Documentation index (Accounts OAuth PKCE, Mail, Tube, Meet, Cloudflare deployment)
- /company : Mission, leadership and contact details
- /contact : Business, support, help and security inboxes, WhatsApp and phone
